title: penstemon alpinus subsp. brandegeei
intro: Penstemon alpinus subsp. brandegeei, commonly known as Brandegee's beardtongue, is a plant species in the family Plantaginaceae. It is native to the southwestern United States and northern Mexico. Penstemon alpinus subsp. brandegeei has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, including its potential health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, which may help alleviate respiratory issues and wounds. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which may help regulate immune function and exhibit antioxidant properties.
